description: This file generates a portion of a web page for displaying and editing cost items within a dashboard. It uses PHP embedded in HTML to render form fields and associated cost details, including conditional styling based on whether the cost is required, and dynamic data insertion for cost attributes and assets.

methods.name: $this->cost
methods.description: Accesses the cost object associated with the current context.

methods.name: $this->raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw associated data, such as the form object.

methods.name: $this->form_row
methods.description: Renders a form input row for the specified form field.

methods.name: $this->asset
methods.description: Generates the URL for an asset resource.

methods.name: $this->types
methods.description: An array mapping cost types to their descriptions.

methods.name: amount_format
methods.description: Formats a numeric amount for display.
